item.title: Remember 9/12, Too
item.description: A day of fear, grief, and fury.

item.title: Schools and Media Accused of Omitting Islamic Terrorists from 9/11 Narratives
item.description: A six-page guidance letter reportedly advises teachers to avoid linking the 9/11 attacks with Islam or Muslims.

item.title: UN Accused of Double Standard on Israel
item.description: The case of Yahav Lichner is cited as evidence that the UN working environment is hostile to Israelis and Jewish people.

item.title: Protection Sought for Houses of Worship Against Disruption
item.description: Amid attacks on religious values, safeguarding sanctuaries is described as more important than ever.
